settings.title: Settings
settings.allowFiveStarHint: Show teams whose builds use 5★ weapons at R1. Off by default — the baseline assumes 4★ weapons only.
settings.onlyMyWeaponsHint: Restrict 5★ weapon teams to the ones you marked as owned in Account.

roster.title: Your characters
roster.noTeamsForChar: No teams available for this character

about.title: About
about.step1: Select the characters you own in the list below.
about.step2: Pick a view in Mode: Recommendations, Tier List, or Team Suggestions.
about.step3: Adjust Settings to control how many new characters you're willing to obtain.
about.step4: Use DPS numbers as reference. You most probably will have different DPS values in your account.
about.step5: Characters marked with a C1 badge are calculated using their C1 versions. All other 5★ characters are C0, 4★ characters are C6.

views.recommendationsHint: The list updates when you change selection or settings
views.emptyRecommendations: No recommendations: either too few characters are selected or no teams fit the current rules.
views.emptyTierlist: Tier list is empty: no characters have teams that include any of your selected characters.
views.noTeamsSelection: No teams available with this selection.
views.noTeamsFiltered: No teams found matching the current filters.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.hint: Mark the characters and 5★ weapons you own. Everything is stored in this browser only — nothing is uploaded.
inventory.charactersHint: Click a character to own them. For 5★ characters set the constellation with − and +.
inventory.weaponsHint: Mark the 5★ weapons you own. Teams that need a 5★ weapon you don't have can then be hidden.
inventory.weaponsNotInDb: Not used by any team in the database yet
inventory.minC1Note: This character is simulated at C1, so C1 is the minimum.
inventory.resetConfirm: Clear all owned characters and weapons?

import.title: Import Characters
import.hint: Upload a GOOD JSON file or paste its contents below. Import replaces your current account.
import.notGood: This does not look like a GOOD export

picker.title: Pick team
picker.hint: Click up to 4 owned characters to narrow down the team — suggestions on the right update with every pick. Click a selected character to remove them, then pick one of the suggested teams.

team.kqmConsHint: 5★ at C0 (or forced C1), 4★ at C6
team.kqmArtHint: 40 substat rolls, at least 2 of each

feedback.title: Leave feedback
feedback.body: Feedback and bug reports go to GitHub Issues. You will be taken to github.com and will need a GitHub account to post.
feedback.warning: Please do not include personal data — issues are public and visible to everyone.

filters.byElementWeapon: Filter teams by element and weapon
filters.title: Filters
